bench_e2e.title: End-to-end SQL bioseq.load + mmsearch vs minimap2 (2/4 Gbp dna4/dna5)
bench_e2e.description: Focused multi-query GPU proof: one same-relation target/query table produces N rows in one custom-scan batch, comparing resident batched Vulkan coordinate path against the production SIMD SQL no-index control.

test_case_descriptions.E2E_BATCH_300M_SEG_COORD: 4 dna4 same-relation coordinate queries against one 300 Mbp target; exercises segmented target geometry with strict GPU batch proof counters without duplicating the target enough to invalidate the setup
test_case_descriptions.E2E_BATCH_4096_INDEL_CIGAR: 4096 dna4 same-relation queries with deterministic query insertion/deletion; requires every GPU CIGAR to contain an I or D op
test_case_descriptions.E2E_BATCH_8192_BOUNDED_CIGAR: 8192 dna4 same-relation queries with <=512 bp alignment spans; strict amortization proof for bounded GPU CIGAR/final-alignment
